The creator, Huang Shan-liao, shares his philosophy on what constitutes a 'right' person in a relationship, emphasizing self-worth, mutual growth, and moving on from toxic dynamics. He uses his book 'Make Days Better Slowly' as a central point of authority to reinforce his message of healing and moving forward.
